import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core'; import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common'; import { SocketService } from '../../../core/services/socket.service'; @Component({ selector: 'app-driver-dashboard', standalone: true, imports: [CommonModule], templateUrl: './dashboard.component.html', styleUrls: ['./dashboard.component.scss'] }) export class DashboardComponent implements OnInit { todayEarnings: number = 87.5; todayRidesCount: number = 15; driverRating: number = 4.9; hasNewRequest: boolean = true; incomingRequest = { rideId: 102, origin: 'El Menzah', destination: 'Centre Ville', price: 6.5 }; recentTrips = [ { time: '14:32', origin: 'El Menzah', destination: 'Centre Ville', price: 6.5 }, { time: '13:15', origin: 'Lac 1', destination: 'Centre Urbain Nord', price: 8.0 } ]; constructor(private socketService: SocketService) {} ngOnInit(): void { this.socketService.connect(); this.socketService.listen('ride:incomingRequest').subscribe((req) => { this.hasNewRequest = true; this.incomingRequest = { rideId: req.rideId, origin: req.originAddress || 'Nouvelle position', destination: req.destAddress || 'Destination', price: req.price || 6.5 }; }); } acceptRequest(): void { this.hasNewRequest = false; this.todayRidesCount++; this.todayEarnings += this.incomingRequest.price; this.socketService.emit('ride:accepted', { rideId: this.incomingRequest.rideId, driverId: 1 }); } ignoreRequest(): void { this.hasNewRequest = false; this.socketService.emit('ride:rejected', { rideId: this.incomingRequest.rideId, driverId: 1 }); } }
